method: R53 independent AH diagnostics: same original-eight-excluded retrospective transfer research cohort 6929 history, no OU exclusions, year calendar matching Jan-May. Crown T24/T12 AH source market prices and actual payoff. Compare T12-selected side vs T24 same future side only as NONEXECUTABLE hindsight payout sensitivity; the side was determined from later T12, not a valid T24 prior signal. Sum exactly over same fixtures; no league/month selection, gate, cap or strategy change. Actual received quote archive analysed separately without transfer source, not independent precommitted trading, no TG or realized fill. Quantify quote line shifts, selected-side odds shifts, price age, line-invariant odds-only payoff attribution vs line-changed payoff. The observations cannot establish the causal cause of 2026 profit decay.
